help.description:
Check a LangGraph graph before it runs: nodes that write the same reducer-less
key in one step, Send targets that do the same, and cycles that never exit.
The graph is imported but never executed, so no LLM is called.
help.epilog:
examples:
  langgraph-preflight app.py:graph
  langgraph-preflight myapp.agent:build_graph --format sarif --output preflight.sarif

exit codes: 0 pass, 1 findings at or above --fail-on, 2 usage or load error
language: --lang, then LANGGRAPH_PREFLIGHT_LANG, then LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG
help.target: file.py:name or package.module:name; name is a compiled graph, a StateGraph, or a function with no arguments that returns one
help.output: write the JSON/SARIF report to PATH; an existing file is replaced only if it is an earlier langgraph-preflight report
help.fail_on: lowest severity that makes the exit code 1 (default: error)
help.lang: display language for help and the table (JSON and SARIF are always English)
help.debug: show the full traceback when loading or analysis fails
err.output_needs_format: --output writes reports only; add --format json or --format sarif
err.missing_target: TARGET is required, for example app.py:graph
err.internal: analysis failed: {error} (run with --debug for the traceback)
err.no_attr: target '{target}' must look like file.py:name or package.module:name
err.module_not_found: module not found: {module} (run from the project folder or install it in this environment)
err.attr_not_found: '{attr}' is not defined at the top level of {module}
err.not_graph: '{attr}' is a {kind}, not a LangGraph StateGraph or compiled graph
err.not_compilable: this graph cannot be built (compile() would fail): {error}
err.output_refused: refusing to overwrite {path}: it is not a langgraph-preflight report
err.output_dir_missing: cannot write {path}: the folder does not exist
table.title: langgraph-preflight  target: {target}  langgraph: {langgraph}
rule.LP001: Nodes that run in the same step write the same key that has no reducer.
rule.LP002: A Send target writes a key that has no reducer; two or more Sends in one step will collide.
rule.LP003: A cycle that can never reach END once entered.
rule.LP004: A node that cannot be reached from START.
rule.LP005: A route whose destinations are not declared, so static analysis cannot follow it.
rule.LP006: Part of the graph could not be analysed.
lp001.static: Key '{key}' has no reducer, but {nodes} write it in the same step {step} ({path}).
lp001.branch: Key '{key}' has no reducer, but {nodes} write it in the same step {step} ({path}) when the branches pick: {choices}.
lp002.send: '{node}' is a Send target and writes {keys} (no reducer): it fails when 2 or more Sends run in one step.
lp003.unconditional: Cycle {cycle} has only unconditional edges; once entered it never ends (installed langgraph default recursion_limit: {limit}).
lp003.branch: Cycle {cycle} has no exit: every possible destination stays inside it (installed langgraph default recursion_limit: {limit}).
lp004.unreachable: Node '{node}' cannot be reached from START.
lp004.send_target: Node '{node}' has no static edge from START; it is reached only through Send.
lp004.open_route: Node '{node}' has no static edge from START; it may be reached only through a route with undeclared destinations.
lp005.branch: Conditional edge '{router}' from {source} has no path_map and no Literal return hint; any returned name is possible and unknown names end the run silently.
lp005.command: Node '{node}' returns Command(goto=...) without a Command[Literal[...]] return hint, so its destinations are unknown.
lp006.unknown_writes.no_source: Keys written by '{node}' are unknown: its source code is not available.
lp006.unknown_writes.not_function: Keys written by '{node}' are unknown: it is not a plain function.
lp006.unknown_writes.subgraph: Keys written by '{node}' are unknown: it is a subgraph (not analysed yet).
lp006.unknown_writes.returns_state: Keys written by '{node}' are unknown: it returns the whole input state.
lp006.unknown_writes.dynamic_return: Keys written by '{node}' are unknown: it returns a value built elsewhere.
lp006.multi_destination: Router '{router}' from {source} returns a list of destinations; only one pick per step is modelled.
lp006.command_multi_destination: Command in '{node}' goes to a list of destinations that is not all string literals; only one pick per step is modelled.
lp006.truncated: Exploration stopped after {max_states} states; findings may be incomplete (raise --max-states).
fix.LP001: Give '{key}' a reducer (Annotated[list, operator.add]) or let each node write its own key.
fix.LP002: Give the key a reducer (Annotated[list, operator.add]) so each Send result is merged.
fix.LP003: Add a conditional exit to END inside the cycle (for example a round counter).
fix.LP004: Add an edge to it or remove the node.
fix.LP005: Pass a path_map to add_conditional_edges or add a Literal[...] return hint.
fix.lp006.truncated: Raise --max-states (now {max_states}) or split the graph into smaller ones.
fix.lp006.command_multi_destination: Write the destinations as string literals, e.g. Command(goto=["p", "q"]), or check this node by hand.
fix.lp006.multi_destination: Check routers that return lists by hand; only one pick per step is modelled.
fix.LP006: Return a dict literal from the node or check this part by hand.
